001package bank.model;
002
003/**
004 * ============================================================================
005 *  TransactionType.java                                       [PERSON B OWNS]
006 * ============================================================================
007 *
008 *  WHAT THIS IS:
009 *      An enum -- a fixed list of allowed values. Every Transaction object has
010 *      one of these as its `type`.
011 *
012 *      Using an enum (instead of a String like "deposit") means the compiler
013 *      catches typos for you.
014 *
015 *  WHO USES IT:
016 *      - TransactionService writes it.
017 *      - StatementGenerator and TransactionHistory filter on it.
018 *      - Person C's JsonStore -- Gson serializes enums as strings automatically.
019 * ============================================================================
020 */
021public enum TransactionType {
022    DEPOSIT,
023    WITHDRAW,
024    TRANSFER_OUT,    // money leaving an account in a transfer
025    TRANSFER_IN,     // money arriving in an account in a transfer
026    INTEREST,        // monthly interest applied
027    FEE              // overdraft fee, etc.
028}
